tool.name: minibwa map
tool.description: Align short/long reads to a reference genome
tool.command:
## Prepare reference: either build index from history FASTA or use cached FASTA #if $reference_source.reference_source_selector == "history": ln -s '$reference_source.fasta_ref' 'ref.fa' && #if $meth: minibwa index --meth -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} 'ref.fa' 'ref' 2>/dev/null && #else: minibwa index -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} 'ref.fa' 'ref' 2>/dev/null && #end if #set $idx_prefix = 'ref' #else: #set $ref_path = str($reference_source.fasta_ref.fields.path) #if $meth: minibwa index --meth -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} '$ref_path' 'ref' 2>/dev/null && #else: minibwa index -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} '$ref_path' 'ref' 2>/dev/null && #end if #set $idx_prefix = 'ref' #end if
minibwa map -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} #if str($preset) != "adap": -x $preset #end if #if str($output_format) == "paf": -f #end if #if $meth: --meth #end if #if $hic: --hic #end if #if str($read_group): -R '$read_group' #end if #if str($base_tag) != "none": -b $base_tag #end if #if $read_length_threshold: -l $read_length_threshold #end if #if $sec_mapping.chain_only: --chain-only #end if #if str($sec_mapping.adap_override) != "default": --adap=$sec_mapping.adap_override #end if #if str($sec_mapping.long_override) != "default": --long=$sec_mapping.long_override #end if #if $sec_mapping.min_seed_len: -k $sec_mapping.min_seed_len #end if #if $sec_mapping.max_seed_occ: -c $sec_mapping.max_seed_occ #end if #if $sec_mapping.chain_gap: -g $sec_mapping.chain_gap #end if #if $sec_mapping.bandwidth: -w $sec_mapping.bandwidth #end if #if $sec_mapping.sec_bandwidth: -W $sec_mapping.sec_bandwidth #end if #if $sec_mapping.min_chain_score: -m $sec_mapping.min_chain_score #end if #if $sec_mapping.min_sec_ratio: -p $sec_mapping.min_sec_ratio #end if #if $sec_mapping.max_secondary: -N $sec_mapping.max_secondary #end if #if $sec_alignment.match_score: -A $sec_alignment.match_score #end if #if $sec_alignment.mismatch_penalty: -B $sec_alignment.mismatch_penalty #end if #if $sec_alignment.gap_open: -O $sec_alignment.gap_open #end if #if $sec_alignment.gap_extend: -E $sec_alignment.gap_extend #end if #if $sec_paired.skip_pairing: -P #end if #if $sec_paired.rescue: --rescue=$sec_paired.rescue #end if #if str($sec_paired.pe_override) != "default": --pe=$sec_paired.pe_override #end if #if $sec_paired.insert_size: -I $sec_paired.insert_size #end if #if $sec_output.skip_unmapped: -u #end if #if $sec_output.outn: --outn=$sec_output.outn #end if #if $sec_output.xa: --xa=$sec_output.xa #end if #if $sec_output.xa_ratio: --xa-ratio=$sec_output.xa_ratio #end if #if $sec_output.copy_comments: -y #end if #if $sec_output.soft_clip_supp: -Y #end if #if str($sec_output.header_line): -H '$sec_output.header_line' #end if #if $sec_output.five_prime_primary: -5 #end if #if $sec_output.batch_size: -K $sec_output.batch_size #end if '$idx_prefix' #if $input_type.input_type == "paired": '$input_type.reads1' '$input_type.reads2' #elif $input_type.input_type == "interleaved": '$input_type.reads' #else: '$input_type.reads' #end if 2>/dev/null > '$output'

param.name: preset
param.label: Preset
param.help: Choose the alignment preset. The default 'adap' works well for both short and long reads.
param.option: adap — mixed short and long reads, optimized for short reads

param.name: read_group
param.label: SAM read group line
param.help: Format: @RG\tID:foo\tSM:bar. Use literal tab characters (as \\t).

param.name: base_tag
param.label: Base alignment tag
param.help: Output an additional base alignment tag in SAM/PAF

param.name: read_length_threshold
param.label: Read length threshold for short-read mode
param.help: In adaptive mode, treat reads shorter than NUM as short reads [325]

param.label: Directional BS-seq mode
param.help: Map directional bisulfite sequencing reads. Requires a --meth index.

param.label: Hi-C mode
param.help: Equivalent to -5P (5'-end primary, skip pairing)

param.name: min_seed_len
param.label: Minimum seed length
param.help: Minimum seed length [19]

param.name: max_seed_occ
param.label: Maximum seed occurrence
param.help: Maximum seed occurrence [250]

param.name: chain_gap
param.label: Chain extension gap
param.help: Stop chain extension if no minimizers within NUM bp [5000]

param.name: bandwidth
param.label: Bandwidth
param.help: Bandwidth for initial chaining and base alignment [500]

param.name: sec_bandwidth
param.label: Secondary chaining bandwidth
param.help: Bandwidth for secondary chaining through long gaps [20000]

param.name: min_chain_score
param.label: Minimum chaining score
param.help: Minimum chaining score [25]

param.name: min_sec_ratio
param.label: Minimum secondary-to-primary ratio
param.help: Minimum secondary-to-primary score ratio [0.5]

param.name: max_secondary
param.label: Maximum secondary alignments
param.help: Retain at most INT secondary alignments [101]

param.label: Chaining only
param.help: Perform chaining only without base alignment

param.name: adap_override
param.label: Adaptive mode override
param.help: Force enable or disable the adaptive mode

param.name: long_override
param.label: Long-read heuristic override
param.help: Force enable or disable the long-read heuristic

param.name: match_score
param.label: Match score
param.help: Match score [2]

param.name: mismatch_penalty
param.label: Mismatch penalty
param.help: Mismatch penalty [8]

param.name: gap_open
param.label: Gap open penalty
param.help: Dual gap open penalty [12,23]. Comma-separated for dual values (e.g. 12,23).

param.name: gap_extend
param.label: Gap extend penalty
param.help: Dual gap extension penalty [2,1]. Comma-separated for dual values (e.g. 2,1).

param.name: rescue
param.label: Mate rescue candidates
param.help: Mate rescue for up to INT candidates [10]

param.name: insert_size
param.label: Insert size distribution
param.help: Mean, std dev, max, min of expected insert size. Comma-separated (e.g. 500,50,700,300).

param.name: skip_unmapped
param.label: Skip unmapped reads
param.help: Don't output unmapped reads

param.name: outn
param.label: Output secondary alignments
param.help: Output up to NUM secondary alignments [0]

param.name: xa
param.label: XA tag threshold
param.help: Output XA tag if >= NUM secondary hits above 80% of best [5]

param.name: xa_ratio
param.label: XA ratio
param.help: Secondary hit is considered for XA tag if score > FLOAT * primary [0.8]

param.name: copy_comments
param.label: Copy FASTA/Q comments
param.help: Copy FASTA/Q comments to output

param.name: soft_clip_supp
param.label: Soft clip supplementary alignments
param.help: Use soft clipping for supplementary alignments in SAM output

param.name: header_line
param.label: SAM header line
param.help: Insert STR into the SAM header (if starts with @) or insert lines from file named STR

param.name: five_prime_primary
param.label: 5'-end primary alignment
param.help: Take alignment with smallest query position as primary

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Batch size
param.help: Process NUM1-NUM2 bp of query sequences in a batch [100m,1g]. Comma-separated (e.g. 100m,1g).

tool.help:
# minibwa map
Minibwa aligns short reads (and accurate long reads) against a reference genome. It is the successor to BWA-MEM, combining BWA-MEM variable-length seeding with minimap2 chaining and SIMD base alignment. Minibwa is approximately 4× faster than BWA-MEM and 2× faster than BWA-MEM2 at comparable accuracy.
## Intended use cases
- Short-read alignment for variant calling - Accurate long-read alignment (for noisy long reads, use minimap2 instead) - Directional bisulfite sequencing (BS-seq) alignment - Hi-C read alignment
## Presets
- **adap** (default) — Mixed short and long reads, optimized for short reads. Equivalent to `-x sr --adap=yes`. - **sr** — Short-read alignment. May give fragmented alignment for long reads. - **lr** — Long-read alignment. May miss highly repetitive alignments for typical short reads.
## Output formats
- **SAM** (default) — Sequence Alignment/Map format - **PAF** — Pairwise mApping Format, TAB-delimited with at least 12 columns
## Limitations
- Minibwa does not work with noisy long reads or spliced RNA-seq reads. - Minibwa does not support undirectional bisulfite sequencing data. - Minibwa does not recognize alternate haplotypes.
